verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents a first-party AI insight feature: AI CSAT scores every call so support teams can measure CSAT and learn how to improve it. Its data-deletion APIs also confirm that the product generates and stores AI data tied to calls and contacts. The evidence covers only this one insight type, from marketing and pricing copy, and does not clearly show suggestions or recommendations. Missing for 10: documented AI suggestions or recommendations, a broader range of in-product insights (e.g. call summaries or analytics), in-depth feature docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI CSAT scores 100% of calls, so support teams can easily measure CSAT and learn how to improve it.
Removes call recordings, screen recordings, transcripts, and AI data from the specified calls.
Call recordings and AI data associated with these contacts are also removed.
